summary: Iteration 2 verified the three new commerce features (Hosted Checkout, API Keys, Webhook Notifications) plus CSV exports end-to-end. Added /app/backend/tests/test_commerce.py with 9 pytest cases covering API key create/list/revoke, X-API-Key auth on /api/v1/checkout/sessions (including revoked-key rejection), hosted checkout create + public GET + public pay + already-paid rejection, webhook events list, endpoint CRUD, test dispatch, auto-dispatched payment.succeeded and refund.succeeded deliveries visible in inspector, and CSV exports (payments/settlements/ledger). Full regression suite: 31/31 backend tests pass (13 foundation + 9 extended + 9 new). Frontend flows validated via Playwright: super-admin login → Acme tenant → API Keys (create shows sk_test_ secret once, list shows masked sk_test_••••XXXX), Hosted Checkout (create returns full shareable URL, session listed, Copy link action present), public /checkout/<token> page (loads amount, email + Pay → success state shown), Webhooks (endpoint add with event checkboxes, Send test, Deliveries tab shows 22 rows including payment.succeeded/refund.succeeded auto-dispatches from backend tests), CSV Export CSV buttons on Payments/Settlements/Balance & Ledger all trigger downloads. No critical bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: API key secret returned once on create; only bcrypt-style hash + last4 persisted (verified via list endpoint — no secret field leaked).
Public checkout /api/public/checkout/{token} correctly uses idempotency_key = f'checkout_{token}' so retries can't double-charge; second pay explicitly returns 400 'already paid'.
Public routes /checkout/:token are correctly registered outside ProtectedRoute in App.js (verified in incognito context — page loaded without auth).
Webhook deliveries dispatched inline post-commit in payment_engine — real HTTP POST to httpbin returned 200 during tests. HMAC signature header X-CloudPay-Signature confirmed via webhook_service.
CSV endpoints stream text/csv with proper Content-Disposition attachment; unauthenticated caller receives 401.
MINOR: /api/public/checkout/{token} expired-check logic in checkout.py:81-83 has a tangled ternary — works but is hard to read; consider refactoring to a clean helper.
MINOR: /api/webhooks/deliveries lacks pagination beyond LIMIT 200 — fine now, add cursor pagination if volume grows.
MINOR: /api/api-keys/{key_id} DELETE returns 200 for revoke — semantically this is an update (active=false), not a delete; consider PATCH for clarity (non-blocking).
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed API keys, checkout sessions, webhook endpoints (auto-deleted) and payments during pytest. Also generated UI-side API key, checkout session (paid via public page), webhook endpoint pointing at httpbin.org, and multiple CSV downloads.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All three new features + CSV exports are fully functional (backend + frontend). Test file test_commerce.py extends the regression suite; run all with `pytest /app/backend/tests/`. Public checkout token is exposed via /api/public/checkout/{token} (no auth). X-API-Key header authenticates against /api/v1/checkout/sessions. Testids follow kebab-case as documented; nav testids are nav-api-keys / nav-checkout / nav-webhooks. Note that older testids nav-access / nav-features remain unchanged from iteration 1.
